# Sαréal618 (Sareal618, Sareal)

Sαréal618 is a family organizer app from Sareal618 LLC. It is also written Sareal618 or Sareal.

It includes a shared family calendar, a private family journal, and a Due list for school deadlines. The core app is free and has no ads. It is made for ages 13 and up.

The web app is at https://app.sareal618.com. The Android app (package com.aineut.app) is in closed testing on Google Play and is not a public listing yet.

Your calendar, journal, and other app data stay on your phone.

Contact: support@sareal618.com
Website: https://www.sareal618.com/
FAQ: https://www.sareal618.com/faq.html
